Notes

Compared to its regular form, it has higher resistances and damage.

Rotrender Scourge of Azzilon has 3 other stages:

  • Rotrender Hexed Horror (immune to all damage)
  • Rotrender (same as Hexed Horror, but vulnerable)
  • Rotrender Hexed Scourge (same as Scourge of Azzilon, but immune to all damage)
